lintRule.DROP_DATABASE: DROP DATABASE deletes the entire database.
lintRule.DROP_TABLE: DROP TABLE deletes the table and all of its data.
lintRule.TRUNCATE: TRUNCATE deletes every row in the table (irreversible).
lintRule.DELETE_WITHOUT_WHERE: DELETE without a WHERE clause deletes every row in the table.
lintRule.UPDATE_WITHOUT_WHERE: UPDATE without a WHERE clause modifies every row in the table.
lintRule.ALTER_DROP_COLUMN: Dropping a column loses that column's data.
lintRule.DROP_INDEX: Dropping an index may affect query performance.
